conventions.convention: The conserved state lies in an open G ⊆ R^m, the flux is C³, and characteristic eigenvalues are ordered increasingly. Characteristic right-eigenvector fields are C².
Weak solutions are measurable and locally bounded, have locally integrable physical flux, satisfy the distributional PDE for t > 0, and approach the initial datum in local L¹ as t decreases to zero.

Jumps use right minus left: f(u_R) − f(u_L) = s(u_R − u_L). Strict Lax i-shocks require λ_i(u_R) < s < λ_i(u_L), together with the stated other-family inequalities. Contacts are excluded from strict Lax shocks.

Wave strength follows the chosen eigenvector normalization. For genuinely nonlinear fields, σDλ_i r_i > 0 selects rarefaction and σDλ_i r_i < 0 selects shock; linearly degenerate fields use the integral curve for both signs.
Ideal-gas Euler uses conserved coordinates (ρ,m,E), γ > 1, ρ > 0, and E > m²/(2ρ); velocity is m/ρ and pressure is (γ−1)(E−m²/(2ρ)).
The pressure residual is Φ(p) = f_L(p) + f_R(p) + u_R − u_L for p > 0. Left star velocity is u_L − f_L(p), and right star velocity is u_R + f_R(p).
A positive matching pressure exists exactly when Φ(0+) < 0. Equality belongs to the no-positive-root threshold, where the limiting rarefaction-tail velocities coincide.

The pressure algorithm assumes terminating exact-real primitives, τ > 0, and N ≥ 0. Its zero lower endpoint is a limiting endpoint, and Newton uses residual tolerance zero and update budget one. Accepted nonroot Newton queries lie between the quarter-width endpoints.
HLL speeds S_L < S_R are supplied inputs. Enclosure of a physical fan is a separate hypothesis; the intermediate assigned model flux need not equal the physical flux of its intermediate state.
At a stationary discontinuity, the Godunov flux uses the common one-sided physical flux, independent of the arbitrary state value assigned at the jump.

load_bearing.statement: For a C³ flux near a strictly hyperbolic state where every characteristic field is genuinely nonlinear or linearly degenerate, there exist δ,η > 0 such that every pair of states within δ has a unique strength vector in (−η,η)^m solving the ordered wave-composition equation. The corresponding ordered waves form a self-similar weak solution. No uniqueness among all weak solutions is asserted.

Near a state with distinct real characteristic eigenvalues, there are jointly C¹ functions v_i(σ,u_0),s_i(σ,u_0) with normalized v_i and S_i(σ;u_0)=u_0+σv_i(σ,u_0), satisfying Rankine–Hugoniot for σ ≠ 0 and having tangent r_i(u_0) at zero. For a genuinely nonlinear field, sufficiently small strengths with σDλ_i(u_0)r_i(u_0) < 0 give strict Lax i-shocks.
Under the hypotheses of def-mixed-characteristic-wave-curve, the map (σ,u) ↦ Ψ_i(σ;u) is C¹ near (0,ū), with Ψ_i(0;u)=u and ∂_σΨ_i(0;u)=r_i(u).

For positive side states and trial pressure p > 0, the defined response functions give star velocities u_L−f_L(p) and u_R+f_R(p), with the stated rarefaction and compressive-shock density formulas. The shock branches satisfy strict acoustic Lax inequalities, and matching star velocities at positive pressure produces a contact.

Φ is C¹ and strictly increasing on (0,∞). If Φ(0+) < 0, it has exactly one positive zero, with 0 < p_* < P for P=2max{p_L,p_R}+6D²/K²+p_L, D=max{0,u_L−u_R}, K=√A_L+√A_R. If Φ(0+) ≥ 0, there is no positive matching pressure.

For admissible non-vacuum data, the specified algorithm terminates after at most N outer iterations while retaining the unique root in its returned bracket. After k completed non-exact iterations its width is at most (3/4)^kP; any budget satisfying (3/4)^NP ≤ τ returns a pressure-bracket status.

A C³ flux whose Jacobian has distinct real eigenvalues at a base state admits local C² eigenvalues and normalized eigenvectors. On a common neighborhood the eigenvalues remain real, simple, and ordered, and the eigenvectors form a basis.

published_dependencies.used_for: The C¹ convention for fluxes and finite-budget Newton residuals.
The C³ flux and C² characteristic-field regularity conventions.
Local eigenpair construction, augmented shock equations, and inversion of the ordered wave-composition equation. Its derivative formula also supports the elementary C² bootstrap for eigenpairs.
Uniform continuity of strength derivatives on compact parameter products in the uniform small-shock Lax argument.
A common local existence interval and compact cylinder for rarefaction integral curves from nearby initial states.
Joint C² dependence of local rarefaction curves on strength and base state on a common compact tube.
Existence of a pressure root between a positive lower pressure with negative residual and the explicit upper bracket.
The scalar Newton correction and finite exact-arithmetic work underlying the one-update Newton call.
The exact one-update Newton interface, including root, invalid-trial, singular-Jacobian, and exhausted-budget statuses.

The Statement specifies the time interval [0,T_+], so the intended interval is recoverable; this is an undefined-symbol presentation defect.
